The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] maintained a hidden '''secret laboratory''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used this place as his base of operations to report to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and to lure [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] so that he could be taken prisoner and be exchanged for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

==Behind the scenes==
During the production of the episode "[[Shadow Warrior]]," there was the idea of having [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Scimitar/Legends|Sith Infiltrator]] parked in this facility, since his ship was never accounted for in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']].
